name: Bagdogra Airport Taxi

reviews.author: Vishnu Singh
reviews.text: Great experience! The driver arrived on time, drove safely, and was very friendly. Will definitely use this service again. Reliable and comfortable ride. Clean car, polite driver, and fair pricing. Highly satisfied with the service. Outstanding service from start to finish. The booking process was easy, and the trip was comfortable and stress-free.

reviews.author: DIPAK SHAW
reviews.text: I would like to express my sincere gratitude to our taxi driver and the entire tour & travel team for making our journey so comfortable, safe, and enjoyable. Your professionalism, punctuality, kindness, and dedication made every moment of the trip memorable. Thank you for your excellent service and warm hospitality. I truly appreciate all your efforts and look forward to traveling with you again in the future.

reviews.author: Balaji Coimbatore
reviews.text:
I had an excellent experience with Pinku Singh’s Bagdora Airport Taxi service! Pinku was incredibly easy to communicate with and always available to help, making the entire booking process smooth and stress-free.
Our driver, Saku Barman, was outstanding. He arrived on time for every pickup, even with Darjeeling’s notorious heavy traffic and narrow, winding streets. His punctuality and professionalism made our airport transfers completely reliable.
I highly recommend Pinku Singh’s Bagdora Airport Taxi to anyone traveling to or from Bagdogra Airport and Darjeeling. Professional, dependable, and hassle-free — exactly what you need in the hills! Thank you! 🙏

reviews.author: Sonal Prasad
reviews.text: One of the best road trips we had, Sandeep , our driver, was fabulous. He provided us with lots of information, which made the trip even more beautiful! I will recommend him highly!

reviews.author: Sudipto Mondal
reviews.text:
I had an excellent experience with this taxi service. The owner Mr. Pinko a true gentleman and his drivers are always on time, executed good professionalism and were courteous throughout our journey.
The booking process was smooth and the fares were transparent with no hidden charges. I would really recommend this taxi service to anyone looking for reliable, efficient and customer focussed transportation.
I will definitely use their services again in the future.

reviews.author: Rohit Saxena
reviews.text: Finest of most reliable taxi services for whole Darjeeling and Sikkim Visit. I will recommend all of you to use this Bagdogra Airport Taxi Services for family or group tours. Thanks Bagdogra Airport Taxi Services 🙏👍
